'''August 1999 Bristol tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG regional qualifier held in Bristol, CT on 22 August 1999. It is known from Andy Klema's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d17">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-23-bristol-connecticut-8-22-99d17/ bristol-connecticut-8-22-99], DeckTech (Andy "RexBanner7" Klema, 23 August 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-23-bristol-connecticut-8-22-99d17/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 22 August 1999
* '''Site:''' Bristol, CT
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 18
